[operator-attested] Resolution attestation for AC4 (commit trailer).

79a8 documented three pre-existing defects that were resolved incidentally by other tickets' work already merged to origin/main (@839477cd72); there is no dedicated `rebar-ticket: 79a8` implementation commit, so AC4's literal "commit carries a trailer" does not apply. Concrete artifacts tying each sub-bug's fix to a merged commit:

- Sub-bug 1 (REBAR_NO_SYNC truthy convention): landed in commit 64bad151b9 ("02c7-1283-afb6-4b97: split config.py — extract raw-input resolution into _config_sources.py"). Current code: src/rebar/_config_sources.py:297 (alias map), :319-322 (_as_bool truthy flip). Regression: tests/unit/test_config_sync_aliases.py — 6 pass.
- Sub-bug 2 (graph=False tri-state over MCP+CLI): current code src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:159 (passes graph=graph), src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py (--graph BooleanOptionalAction default None), src/rebar/llm/completion.py:479 (graph: bool|None). Regression: tests/interfaces/facades/test_verify_completion_facades.py + tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_child_scope.py — 44 pass.
- Sub-bug 3 (test fake verify_signature kind=): current code tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_verification_workflow.py:124-125 (kind=None param). Regression: same file — 10 pass.

The completion verifier's own run on 2026-08-07 confirmed ACs 1-3 as codebase-verifiable PASS; only this AC4 process artifact required this out-of-repo attestation. Closing as regression (defects real, fixes landed).
